opening.argument: The presentation promotes OneCoin through a money-linked opportunity built around participation, personal earnings, and broader claims of prosperity. It encourages viewers to reach out to “your friends and family” while describing an education package with certificates and points, making the offer an active recruiting and purchase proposition rather than neutral discussion. Viewers are told they can “lock in your position for free” and later upgrade to a package that “could make you huge difference in your life,” while an earnings comparison is used to reinforce the financial appeal. These claims connect participation and package upgrades with the prospect of meaningful personal benefit.
